review.summary: Actual final/source sheet and full hero preserve the faucet lever gap, curved spout/outlet collar, cylindrical stem and base with coherent reflective metal. Fresh FBX/GLB verification passes at 14,575 triangles. No major component loss or visible material regression.

issues.problem: The existing neck seam and fine lever lines remain; neutral low shading has slight base/edge undulations that are largely compensated in the final metal appearance.

review.summary: Actual multiview sheet and full hero retain a coherent polished metal faucet, lever clearance, spout collar and base. No major material spill or lost component. Warm reflected tones vary from the reference but still read as metal.

issues.problem: Thin source surface lines and small neck irregularities remain visible under reflective shading; verify reduction does not amplify them or add dents.

review.summary: Actual multiview sheet and full hero retain the cylindrical body/base, separate upper lever, clearance above the curved spout and the outlet collar. All main components remain connected and the reference silhouette is recognizable.

issues.problem: Small edge nicks and a slightly uneven lever-to-body seam remain; inspect their chrome appearance and reduced output.
